description:
Edgely Console puts your servers and your own shell inside NetBeans: SSH
        terminals, a local terminal (PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash and WSL on
        Windows; zsh, bash and fish on macOS and Linux), SFTP and FTP/FTPS file
        browsers, local and remote Docker, and saved connections whose passwords and
        keys stay in the operating system's keystore. Free, no account needed.
